place: Reiek Heritage Peak and Model Village
text: Reiek is a mountain and tourist spot 29 km from Aizawl, Mizoram, India. It rests at an elevation of 1,465 metres overlooking Aizawl and offers a view of the surrounding valleys and hills. On a clear day, the plains of Bangladesh can be seen from the top of the hill. Reiek Hill is surrounded by thick lush green temperate trees and bushes.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
